newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end moderately lower, near lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end moderately lower, near lows.

text.p: April 24 - U.S. debt futures ended lower, near lows. Traders said remarks by Fed governor Meyer, who said US economy growing at unsustainable rate, solid momentum in Q2, added weight. They also cited Japanese press reports that Japan MOF preparing order to halt operation at Nissan Life Insurance. Supplies plus dealer, hedge fund, hedge sales, added pressure.
